<function name="IsCompletelyVisible" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether this <page>CNavArea</page> can completely (i.e. all corners of this area can see all corners of the given area) see the given <page>CNavArea</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2020.08.12</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="area" type="CNavArea">The <page>CNavArea</page> to test.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the given area is visible from this area</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
